NAMEcheap DNS Records for trakalerts.com
=========================================

Copy these EXACTLY into Namecheap Advanced DNS:

RECORD 1: SPF (TXT)
-------------------
Type: TXT Record
Host: @
Value: v=spf1 include:_spf.resend.com ~all
TTL: Automatic

RECORD 2: DKIM (TXT)
--------------------
Type: TXT Record
Host: default._domainkey
Value: v=DKIM1;k=rsa;
TTL: Automatic

RECORD 3: DMARC (TXT) - Optional
---------------------------------
Type: TXT Record
Host: _dmarc
Value: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@trakalerts.com
TTL: Automatic

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Host "default._domainkey" (NOT "resend._domainkey")
- Copy the ENTIRE DKIM value (one long line, no spaces)
- Ignore the "BEGIN/END PUBLIC KEY" text - that's not for DNS
- Save all changes after adding records
- Wait 10-30 minutes for verification
